# Fixture provenance

- Synthetic conformance cases and performance fixtures are generated by [`scripts/corpus.py`](../../scripts/corpus.py), using NumPy 2.5.4 `PCG64` with seed `0x8716123` and per-depth offsets. Generated samples follow the repository license. The 16-bit lossless ramp includes every integer from 0 to 65535. The benchmark uses a different corpus with smooth, edge, texture and noise patterns.
- ITU-T T.87 Annex E images are downloaded for correctness checks at the pinned CharLS 2.4.5 revision `14b654dff1efed4d04e278ff3e99f0a486cf20cc`. `test16.pgm`, `t16e0.jls` and `t16e3.jls` are used for value comparisons. `t8c0e0.jls`, `t8c1e0.jls`, `t8c2e0.jls`, `t8sse0.jls` and `t8nde0.jls` exercise unsupported features. Exact SHA-256 values are in [`scripts/corpus.py`](../../scripts/corpus.py). The images are fetched on demand into `.tools/conformance/`. The ITU reference distribution identifies its software as Copyright © Hewlett-Packard Company 1995–1999 and for conformance testing. CharLS is Copyright © 2007 Jan de Vaan and Victor Derks, BSD-3-Clause. [Pinned dataset notes](https://github.com/team-charls/charls/blob/14b654dff1efed4d04e278ff3e99f0a486cf20cc/test/conformance/README.md), [CharLS license](https://github.com/team-charls/charls/blob/14b654dff1efed4d04e278ff3e99f0a486cf20cc/LICENSE.md), [ITU reference distribution](https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-T.87-199806-I/en).
- The lily-of-the-valley microscopy image was acquired by Genevieve Buckley at Monash Micro Imaging in 2018 and is available under CC0. The dataset is pinned via scikit-image v0.26.0’s source registry and checked against SHA-256 `395c2f0194c25b9824a8cd79266920362a0816bc9e906dd392adce2d8309af03`. The benchmark reads the original `(4, 922, 922)` uint16 planes with tifffile 2026.11.16 and takes channel index 1, rows and columns 205–716 inclusive. Samples stay at their original integer values, with effective depth 12. [Dataset description and CC0 license](https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.lily), [Pinned source registry](https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.26.0/src/skimage/data/_registry.py).
- The lunar image comes from the public-domain NASA LOLA LDEM_4 altimetry grid. [NASA source, exact transformation and checksums](LUNAR_DATA.md).
